previous.explanation_en: 国家 is the conventional word for a country or nation understood as a political community. 国 points to the country or polity; 家’s contribution to the whole is not fully predictable from its usual sense of “home” or “household.”
previous.caveat_en: Do not interpret 国家 as a literal “country-household”; it functions as a conventional word for a nation or country.

parts.contribution_en: part of the conventional word; its usual sense of “home” or “household” does not fully explain the whole

requests.reason: Research and explain what 家 contributes to 国家. The current not-predictable caveat may reflect missing research; distinguish historical attested senses from a supported account of development.
